_purpose: Shape example of one pre-match feature record. The identity/context block holds REAL values taken from the dataset. Every derived value is null on purpose: feature values were NOT computed in this phase.
_rulesApplied: Every derived value must come from matches strictly earlier than match_date.
The statistics of THIS match (goals, shots, corners, cards, half-time score) are targets or in-match data and are never inputs.
A feature with insufficient history stays null - it is never filled with a default or an average.

identity._note: Real row from FORMAX_HISTORICAL_MODEL_ELIGIBLE.csv, used only to show the shape.

target._note: Shown for completeness. This is the label, never an input.

context._note: tie_* is null because DOMESTIC_LEAGUE has no two-legged ties. is_neutral_venue is null because the dataset does not carry venue neutrality at all.

scoring_rolling._window: one of rolling_3 | rolling_5 | rolling_10 | time_decayed - NOT SELECTED YET
scoring_rolling._availability: derivable for 93.04 percent of matches at the >=5 prior-match threshold

form._note: Form is not W W L W W - it carries results, goal difference, opponent strength and venue context.

match_statistics_rolling._coverage: 70.41 percent of the dataset overall, 88.91 percent of DOMESTIC_LEAGUE, 0 percent for every UEFA type and for 2025/26

_thisMatchValuesForReference._warning: THESE ARE THE VALUES OF THIS MATCH AND ARE FORBIDDEN AS INPUTS. Listed only to make the rule concrete.

schedule._warning: Fixture counters undercount systematically - domestic cups, internationals and friendlies are outside the 17 locked competitions.

head_to_head._availability: at least one previous meeting exists for 78.94 percent of matches

domestic_season_to_date._note: Null here is also correct on matchday 1: nothing has been played in the season yet. Season-final standings are forbidden.

future_blocks_not_available._status: NOT_AVAILABLE - 0 percent coverage in every owned source; no hand-made scoring scheme is defined

audit._note: For leakage test T1 this list must be produced at least once and every source match date must be strictly earlier than match_date.
